Market today: Tech is showing some life after a rough patch, with chip names bouncing back. The real driver seems to be a bit of positive sentiment, though it's still fragile.

Your holdings: CRWD (30.88%), QQQ (0.68%), SMCI (-26.95%), SNOW (-5.13%), MU (-30.49%), SOXL (-55.7%), SPAL (-36.1%), QQQI (-3.13%), SMH (-13.56%). Many are marked 'SELL' and are down significantly, especially the leveraged ETFs. Your stops are being tested.

Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs (MU, SOXL, SPAL) and SMCI. They're deep in the red and on margin, so any further drops are amplified.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your biggest losers and protecting your capital, especially with margin involved.
plays: CRWD: Consider trimming some profit if it continues to rally, given its 'SELL' status.
SMCI: Watch the stop at 37.3. A break below could signal further downside.
